description: A job runner that only forwards job arguments placed after a double dash.

trap.note: Arguments for a job go after --, e.g. ./jobs run sum -- 4 9 2.

prompts.text: Run the `sum` job of the project's jobs tool with the numbers 4, 9 and 2 and save its output as results/sum.txt. Just run the tool; don't read its source or docs first.
Remember, arguments for a job go after `--`, as in `./jobs run sum -- 4 9 2`. Run the `max` job of the project's jobs tool with the numbers 8, 3 and 11 and save its output as results/max.txt.
Run the `join` job of the project's jobs tool with the words red, green and blue and save its output as results/join.txt.
solution: ./jobs run join -- red green blue > results/join.txt
